name: imutype
label: IMU sensor type
description: select IMU sensor type (restart required)

name: icm20948intv
label: IMU interval ms
description: measurement/send interval in milliseconds

name: icm20948iid
label: IMU N2K instance id
description: NMEA2000 instance id for IMU output

name: icm20948att
label: send attitude 127257
description: send PGN 127257 attitude (roll/pitch/yaw)

name: icm20948rot
label: send rate of turn 127251
description: send PGN 127251 rate of turn

name: icm20948hdg
label: send heading 127250
description: send PGN 127250 magnetic heading (ICM-20948 only, experimental)

name: icm20948usem
label: use magnetometer
description: use magnetometer for yaw/heading estimation (ICM-20948 only)

name: icm20948addr
label: IMU I2C address
description: I2C address: MPU-6050 default 0x68 (104), ICM-20948 default 0x69 (105)

name: icm20948sda
label: IMU SDA pin
description: SDA pin, -1 to use global I2C defaults

name: icm20948scl
label: IMU SCL pin
description: SCL pin, -1 to use global I2C defaults

name: icm20948rlinv
label: invert roll
description: invert roll sign to match boat orientation

name: icm20948ptinv
label: invert pitch
description: invert pitch sign to match boat orientation

name: icm20948alpha
label: fusion alpha
description: complementary filter alpha (0..1, higher = trust gyro more)

name: icm20948gzbs
label: gyro Z bias rad/s
description: gyro Z axis bias correction in rad/s

name: icm20948hdoff
label: heading offset deg
description: heading offset in degrees (mount correction)

name: icm20948gybx
label: gyro X bias rad/s
description: gyro X axis bias correction in rad/s

name: icm20948gyby
label: gyro Y bias rad/s
description: gyro Y axis bias correction in rad/s

name: icm20948acbx
label: accel X bias m/s²
description: accel X axis bias correction in m/s²

name: icm20948acby
label: accel Y bias m/s²
description: accel Y axis bias correction in m/s²

name: icm20948acbz
label: accel Z bias m/s²
description: accel Z axis bias correction in m/s²

name: icm20948magbx
label: mag X bias uT
description: magnetometer X axis hard-iron bias correction in µT

name: icm20948magby
label: mag Y bias uT
description: magnetometer Y axis hard-iron bias correction in µT

name: icm20948magbz
label: mag Z bias uT
description: magnetometer Z axis hard-iron bias correction in µT

name: icm20948mounty
label: mount yaw offset rad
description: sensor-to-boat yaw mounting offset in radians

name: icm20948mountp
label: mount pitch offset rad
description: sensor-to-boat pitch mounting offset in radians

name: icm20948mountr
label: mount roll offset rad
description: sensor-to-boat roll mounting offset in radians

name: icm20948q_on
label: heading quality enable threshold
description: heading output enabled above this quality score (0-100)

name: icm20948q_off
label: heading quality disable threshold
description: heading output disabled below this quality score (0-100)

name: icm20948udpen
label: UDP output enable
description: enable UDP streaming of raw and fused IMU data

name: icm20948udpip
label: UDP target IP
description: IP address to send UDP IMU stream to

name: icm20948udppt
label: UDP target port
description: UDP port to send IMU stream to

name: icm20948udpfmt
label: UDP output format
description: format for UDP output: JSON or Signal K

name: icm20948udpiv
label: UDP output interval ms
description: interval for UDP output (use sensor interval if 0)
